name: NTR'ed by My Friend
source:
Alan and Cristina are doing their best to maintain a long-distance relationship—until Cristina visits Alan and stays in his apartment, where another man lives: Blake, his easygoing, sharp-witted roommate. What begins as casual, harmless camaraderie soon spirals into something more dangerous.

Will love endure? Will betrayal take root? Or will temptation be overcome at the very last moment?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/user/about?u=78902436]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
艾伦和克里斯蒂娜竭尽全力维持异地恋，直到克里斯蒂娜拜访艾伦并住在他的公寓里，那里住着另一个男人：布莱克，他随和、机智的室友。一开始只是随意、无害的友情很快就会演变成更危险的事情。

爱情会长久吗？背叛会生根吗？还是会在最后一刻克服诱惑？

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/user/about?u=78902436]Patreon[/url]]
